_comment: Being crushed by the sea over you (design 7.1.2). Scaled 'never', because the water does not care how
hard the world is: an abyss is the same depth on peaceful as on hard, and the counterplay is gear and
nerve rather than a difficulty slider.
Exhaustion is nought. The hunger drain on a hazard you are meant to spend minutes inside would be a
second, quieter timer nobody asked for, and the descent already has one.
